messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting migration wave 4 in 30m. Preemptive throttle = 50% on backfills, stagger window 00:30-02:00 UTC. Deploybot will run against shard range 5000-7500. If tail latency or lock waits spike, we'll trigger fallback to read-only replica and pause backfills. Link to release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.3.1

deploybot: [automated] job queued: migration_id=mig_2026_03_22_wave4 start_in=30m throttle=0.5 stagger=5m fallback_policy=regional-failover. To abort: `/deploybot abort mig_2026_03_22_wave4 --reason <text>`. Logs will stream to #eng-releases.

henry: confirm rollback criteria? what's our threshold for abort vs slow-down? :eyes:

maria: primary abort triggers: error_rate > 1% for 5m OR avg lock_wait_ms > 30000 for 3m OR sustained P95 latency regressions > 2x baseline. Otherwise we drop throttle to 20% and extend stagger.

samir: re: locks — can we run a preflight to detect long-lived txns on those shards? quick check: `SELECT pid, query, state, age(now(), query_start) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='prod' AND state!='idle' ORDER BY query_start;` Would prefer 10m quiet window before start.

maria: we have a 10m quiet drain scheduled 10m before start — ops-sre to confirm. If any txns > 2m we abort start.

sophie: app version pinned for this rollout? important for schema compatibility.

maria: pinned to `webapp@v2.3.1` across canary fleet. Release notes include compatibility table (breaking changes: none for reads; writes guarded behind feature flag).

ops-bot: [canary-run] canary migration on shard 5200 completed: rows touched=12k, avg_latency_tok=18ms, errors=0. Recommend throttle=0.4 for initial waves.

henry: ok — lowers risk. Keep the abort command ready. Also adding a manual holdpoint at +15m after start so we can inspect.

samir: one more ask — please ensure `pg_stat_activity` retention and `pg_locks` sampling enabled on replicas for the window. I can add a watch script: `watch-locks.sh` that posts to this thread.

maria: agreed. samir, please attach the script. If deploybot sees `lock_wait_count > 50` across cluster we'll auto-pause and notify oncall.

samir: attaching simple script (paste):
```
#!/bin/bash
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted;" -t | grep -v '^\s*$' | while read c; do
  if [ "$c" -gt 0 ]; then
    curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"deploybot-signal: pending_locks='$c'"}' https://hooks.internal/releasebot
  fi
done
```

deploybot: acknowledged. Watchhook registered: watch-locks.sh -> deploybot.signals.watch. Auto-pause threshold = 50 pending locks.

henry: I'll be oncall during the window. ping me with `@henry` if abort happens.

sophie: added a short blurb to release notes under "operational notes" about the preemptive throttle and rollback steps.

maria: thanks everyone. final checklist: 1) confirm quiet-drain (ops) 2) confirm watchhook (samir) 3) pinned version verified (sophie) 4) holdpoint at +15m (henry). If all good we'll proceed at T+30m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: quiet-drain confirmed by ops-sre.

maria: launching — will post deploybot start message when job flips.

deploybot: [automated] mig_2026_03_22_wave4 started at 1765436840. staging: shard 5000-5100. live updates -> #eng-releases.
